releaseNotes: Smart Search reliability fix: OCR content indexing now runs in small progressive batches, restarts automatically when a content search is typed, prioritizes WhatsApp files and Screenshots, retries difficult images through a bounded bitmap OCR path, rebuilds the local content index, and scans up to 12 pages for image/scanned PDFs. Filename search remains immediate while OCR indexing proceeds. Existing voice search, compact File Types, Converter cleanup, and opening motion are preserved.
